title: Update Email
statement: Update Email — working draft assembled in the workbook
rows: Internal working draft generated from the same approved research objects. Edit locally; do not send without review.
Review October 2026 CrowdStrike signal and evidence

Team,

Bottom line: CrowdStrike’s October 2026 demand signal remains positive. Net Score was 37.14, up 0.69 points versus July 2026 and 10.54 points versus October 2025. Pervasion rose to 40.90.

What changed: Sequential Net Score movement was modest, while the year-over-year recovery was materially larger. Q/Q and Y/Y Z-Scores were 0.129 and 0.892; the raw values are available, but approved interpretation bands remain Source Needed.

Research implication: The evidence supports continued recovery and broader deployment, with selective enterprise strength and geographic divergence. It does not validate a causal or predictive relationship to Net New ARR.

Review requested: Please approve, revise, or reject SIG-02 and the proposed SIG-02 → KPI-003 bridge. We also need cohort/regional Ns, current retention, current shared-account data, and approved Z-Score methodology bands.

Evidence: ETR-OCT26-NS; ETR-OCT26-PV; ETR-OCT26-ZS; ETR-OCT26-G2K; ETR-OCT26-F500; ETR-OCT26-LARGE.

Human Review Required.
